entries.text: The House Committee on Rules reported an original measure, H. Rept. 119-825, by Mrs. Fischbach.
entries.core: The House Committee on Rules reported an original measure, H. Rept. 119-825, by Mrs. Fischbach
entries.label: Reported by committee (House)

entries.text: The resolution provides for consideration of H.R. 9576, H.R. 10326, H.J.Res. 210, and H.J.Res. 213 under a closed rule with one hour of debate and one motion to recommit on each measure. The resolution provides for a motion to concur in the Senate amendments to H.R. 5334.
